name: Fish oil, salmon
description: Oil extracted from fish from the salmon family (Oncorhynchusspp. andSalmo salarLinnaeus 1758).

name: Common bean
description: Seed of common bean (Phaseolus vulgarisL.). Common beans are normally used for human food but can occasionally be fed to livestock. The common bean is known under many names (kidney bean, French bean, navy bean...), depending on the variety.

name: Olive oil cake, with pits, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of olive fruits (Olea europaeaL.). This product contains pits. It has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Wheat middlings, starch 20-30%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing between 20% and 30% of starch (as fed).

name: Copper lysine
description: Lysine and copper complex used as a source of organic copper. These products have a variable copper content.

name: Palm kernel meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of palm fruit kernels (Elaeis guineensisJacq. orElaeis melanococcaauct.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Ferric pyrophosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Fe4(P2O7)3. Other name: iron(III) pyrophosphate.

name: Grape pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of winery or grape juice manufacture obtained from the pressure of grapes (Vitis viniferaL.). Grape pulp typically contains the pulp and skins, but not the seeds (pips) or the branches. It is sometimes synonym of grape marc or grape pomace, though the latter product often contains also the seeds and branches.

name: Zinc carbonate FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnCO3. It is a white crystalline solid or powder that is insoluble in water. This product is of feed grade quality.

name: Calcium iodate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound composed of calcium and iodate anion with the formula Ca(IO3)2.

name: Cereal offal, crude fibre > 14%
description: Byproduct of the processing of cereal grains of undetermined species. This product contains more than 14% (as fed) of crude fibre.

name: Fish oil, capelin
description: Oil extracted from the capelin fish (Mallotus villosusO. F. Müller 1776).

name: Sheanut oil meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of sheanut seeds (Vitellaria paradoxaC. F. Gaertn.) for the production of sheanut butter. This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Rice, brown
description: Unpolished rice grain (Oryza sativaL.) without the hulls but with the outer grain layers.

name: Sunflower meal, oil 5-20%, non dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of whole sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Corn gluten feed
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch obtained from maize grain (Zea maysL.) by wet milling. It is composed of bran and gluten, to which steeping liquor and germs, deoiled or not, may be added. The values below are given for dried corn gluten feed but this product is also sold in humid form. Other name: maize gluten feed.

name: Diiodosalicylic acid
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula I2C6H2(OH)CO2H. Full name: 3,5-diiodosalicylic acid.

name: L-isoleucine
description: L-isoleucine produced by fermentation

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 46% protein + oil
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 46% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Wheat middlings, starch > 40%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing more than 40% starch (as fed).
